prior_summary: Red-frame Cartesian action diffusion makes pickup, grasp, and carried-red targets equivariant to the red pose observed at each replan while retaining robot configuration and scene relations.
applicable_conditions: Prefer with drawer_position above 0.26 m when red is exposed and reliably localized, especially if its pickup pose is displaced or entry occurs before red release. Transformed poses must remain reachable and collision-free.
termination_guidance: Nominally continue through red placement/opening/retreat and the supervised blue pickup overlap; switch cleanly after red remains on the pad and blue/TCP co-motion on initial lift is observable.
limitations: Object-frame equivariance is frozen per chunk, does not prove grasp/contact recovery, and does not make the post-release handoff invariant to blue displacement. IK failure and furniture collision remain possible.
